Description: Linode **user accounts** are checked to ensure they have **restricted** access, following least-privilege principles.
Risk: Unrestricted users have full account access, increasing the blast radius of a **credential compromise**.

Code.Other:
1. Log in to the Linode Cloud Manager
2. Navigate to Identity & Access under Administration
3. Click on the user and go to Assigned Roles tab to update access permissions

Recommendation.Text: Review each user in the account and ensure they only have access to required entities.
